speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. I see you are a child with a 3-week history of fatigue, fever, easy bruising, and severe leg pain. To understand what is causing these symptoms, please tell me: how old are you, and have you had any recent illnesses or injuries?

speaker: Patient
text: 4-year-old girl. The patient has been experiencing generalized fatigue and easy bruising for 3 weeks. Over the past week, she has developed a fever and severe leg pain that wakes her up at night.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Leukemia (likely ALL)

The patient is a 4-year-old with classic signs including fever, fatigue, bruising (suggesting thrombocytopenia), and severe bone pain (suggesting marrow expansion). This constellation of symptoms is highly suspicious for acute leukemia.

REQUEST TEST: Complete Blood Count with Differential
REQUEST TEST: Peripheral Blood Smear
REQUEST IMAGES: X-ray of long bones (to rule out osteomyelitis or fractures, though leukemia is more likely).
